en.p: For a real number $p\ (p\ge 1)$ and the function $f(x)=(x+a)^2$, let A be the point where the two parabolas

meet in the first quadrant. Let $\mathrm{F_1}$, $\mathrm{F_2}$ be the foci of parabolas $C_1$, $C_2$, respectively. What is the value of the constant $a$ such that there is exactly one $p$ satisfying $\overline{\mathrm{AF_1}}=\overline{\mathrm{AF_2}}$? [4 points]
